message: The other day, my neighbor was eyeing the sky while I was stocking up on a few extra cans of soup. "You worry too much, Linda," he said with a chuckle. Fast forward to last night, and there he was, knocking on my door, asking if I had any extra flashlights. I smiled, handed him one, and thought about how sometimes a little prep can turn those 'I told you so' moments into friendly exchanges instead. 🌦️
